summary.en: A zero-dependency CLI that records failures and recalls the useful lessons before similar work starts.
summary.jp: 外部依存のない CLI ツール。失敗を記録し、似た作業を始める前に教訓を呼び出す。

mine: Built a PostToolUse hook that records failures automatically as they happen
Built a lightweight token-overlap search to surface relevant past failures before repeating an error class
Built an eval command to measure recall effectiveness

cardLine.en: Records failures, and recalls them before you repeat one.
cardLine.jp: 失敗を記録し、同じ轍を踏む前に思い出させる。
